authority.note: This packet frames required adversarial reviews; script generation never answers or decides them.

limitations: Evidence context is assembled mechanically and may include irrelevant rows; the reviewer must judge relevance.
A pending red-team prompt is not a judgment_review and cannot support an M6 decision.
No script-authored verdict or recommendation is permitted.
Priority weights allocate review attention only.
Later judgment must preserve Commander-first identity and bracket-specific context.

reviews.adversarial_challenge: Assume multiple permanent types are answered over several turns. Identify which strategic routes actually rebuild and which collapse after repeated removal.

value: Don't homogenize into generic Grixis storm (source guardrail).
Don't claim the three exception cards are Commander-legal.
Don't build around the misdescribed source text for Bjorna/Cecily.

blueprint_failure_modes.description: Cecily dies in combat or can't attack safely; free casts never happen.
Wheels replace the hand and can drop below eleven.
Outside the project the list is not Commander-legal (three exceptions); the official projection swaps them out and loses power.
mitigations: Projection is labeled and never canonical

value.interaction: Counters to protect combo turns; Toxic Deluge and Cyclonic Rift as resets.
value.mana: Rituals (Seething Song, Mana Geyser, Jeska's Will) and rocks.
value.protection: Lightning Greaves for Cecily's attack; Fierce Guardianship.

accepted_role.advances_plan: Cecily (significant) turns attacks into a card and, with 11+ cards, a free spell. Bjorna (supporting/incidental) is a small repeatable ping/goad that uses artifact tokens: it kills X/1s and redirects attacks on opponents' turns. As a pair they are supporting; the deck wins with draw-and-wheel combos that don't need either commander.
accepted_role.honest_note: The source blueprint misdescribes both commanders (Bjorna does not grant haste on noncreature spells; Cecily triggers on attacking, not combat damage; M1 bjorna-12). On current Oracle Bjorna is close to incidental and Cecily is a significant but combat-exposed engine. The approval dossier calls the pair the 'strategic center'; GrokBot's reading is that the draw/wheel/Peer package is.
